subject: Post-call recap: DPA role, SCC module options, and vendor questionnaire (Cloudline Analytics)
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Jones <emma.jones@cloudlineanalytics.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-07-22T16:05:00Z
Subject: Post-call recap: DPA role, SCC module options, and vendor questionnaire (Cloudline Analytics)

Hi Emma — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a mutual action plan.

Call summary (high level):
- Cloudline is evaluating Redwood for inference on analytics workloads (PII in some pipelines).
- Primary privacy concerns: controller/processor assignment for customer data, SCC module selection for EU processing, SOC 2 evidence, and HIPAA applicability for a subset of workloads.

Open asks / next steps from our side:
1) Please confirm Cloudline’s desired controller/processor roles (you indicated Cloudline would be the controller and Redwood would act as processor — can you confirm in writing?).
2) We requested your vendor security questionnaire; attaching a stub in your reply helps speed reviews. If you prefer, we can initiate our VSQ instance and pre-fill items.
3) SCC/module preference: for EU data, do you prefer the standard Controller-to-Processor module (EU Model Clauses) or a more prescriptive Module variant? If you name a preference we’ll align the DPA draft accordingly.
4) Evidence: SQLite of SOC 2 — Redwood has a SOC 2 Type II report available (summary attached). If HIPAA controls are required, please flag which product paths will handle PHI so we can loop Legal & Security.

Proposed timeline:
- Today/T+1: Cloudline confirms controller/processor and uploads completed/partial vendor questionnaire.
- T+2: We share a DPA draft with SCC module aligned to your preference (DocuSign link will be provided).
- T+5: Legal review and aim to sign or define redlines.

Attachments: redwood_soc2_summary.pdf (summary of our controls).

If that all looks right, I’ll push the DPA draft and a short answers doc for your legal team.

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0182

From: Emma Jones <emma.jones@cloudlineanalytics.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Cloudline Analytics Legal <legal@cloudlineanalytics.com>
Date: 2027-07-22T16:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: DPA role, SCC module options, and vendor questionnaire (Cloudline Analytics)

Hi Kimberly — thanks for the clear recap. Confirming the following from Cloudline’s side: 

- Controller/Processor: Cloudline will be the Controller for customer data; we expect Redwood to be listed as a Processor in the DPA.
- SCC preference: we prefer the standard Controller-to-Processor (EU Model Clauses) path — i.e., the module that maps Controller -> Processor. If you have a naming convention for that module, call it whatever internal label works, but it should be the Controller-to-Processor clauses.
- SOC 2: good to see the summary; our security team will request the full report under NDA later in the process.
- HIPAA: we have a separate product path that will handle PHI for one pilot; please mark that as a potential HIPAA scope so Security can evaluate the BAA requirement.

Attached is our partially-completed vendor security questionnaire (cloudline_vendor_questionnaire.pdf) — we filled the high-level sections and left detailed controls for your Security team to confirm. Please review and tell us if you want us to complete anything differently.

Timeline: we can aim for the DPA review next week. Legal is available for a synchronous 30-minute redline session on Tue, Jul 27 if that helps.

Thanks,
Emma Jones
Head of Procurement & Security Programs | Cloudline Analytics
emma.jones@cloudlineanalytics.com

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-07-22T16:45:00Z
Subject: RE: Post-call recap: DPA role, SCC module options, and vendor questionnaire (Cloudline Analytics)

Kimberly / Lauren —

Quick internal note on approach and recommended language before we send the DPA draft to Cloudline:

1) Controller/Processor: Accept Cloudline’s request to be Controller and Redwood as Processor. Draft the DPA to reflect Controller -> Processor responsibilities and limit Redwood’s processing to the described service scopes (analytics inference + ephemeral logs for debugging only).

2) SCC module: Cloudline requested the Controller-to-Processor model clauses. We should use the EU Model Clauses variant with a Processor Annex that enumerates subprocessors and security measures. Label it in the DPA as "EU Model Clauses (Controller -> Processor)" so their legal team recognizes it quickly.

3) Evidence & timeline: Prepare the full SOC 2 Type II report for secure transfer (we’ll need NDA + SSO access). For HIPAA scope, flag the pilot dataset and gate the BAA conversation until product/legal confirm reach and processing location (we currently have EU regions with appropriate controls).

4) Next steps (internal):
- Kimberly: send the DPA draft (use template DPA-processor-v3) with the EU Model Clauses option pre-selected and include our SOC 2 summary.
- Lauren: please add the HubSpot task (CL-7862) and set owner to Rishi for follow-up.
- Legal: loop if Cloudline asks for alternate SCC wording.

I’ll also review the attached cloudline_vendor_questionnaire.pdf and return notes with any mismatches.

Rishi Malhotra
Head of Security & Trust | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Jones <emma.jones@cloudlineanalytics.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Cloudline Analytics Legal <legal@cloudlineanalytics.com>
Date: 2027-07-22T17:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: DPA role, SCC module options, and vendor questionnaire (Cloudline Analytics)

Emma — thanks, that’s perfect and aligns with our plan. Next steps from Redwood: 

- I’m attaching a DPA draft (dpa_proposed_redwood_v1.docx) that pre-selects the "EU Model Clauses (Controller -> Processor)" module and lists Redwood as Processor. Please expect a DocuSign link shortly: https://docusign.example.com/link/DOC-98765.
- Rishi will review the VSQ and provide comments by EOD tomorrow; we’ll note any control gaps and suggested remediations.
- If Cloudline wants a live redline session, Tue Jul 27 at 10:00am BST works for our Legal/Procurement — please confirm and we’ll calendar invite.

Could you please: 
- Upload the completed vendor questionnaire back to the VSQ link above or reply with an updated PDF.
- Confirm whether you want the SOC 2 full report under NDA; we’ll generate access if yes.

Thanks again for the productive conversation. Looking forward to solidifying the DPA so we can start the pilot.

Attachments: dpa_proposed_redwood_v1.docx

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
